scope: Read-only numerical/source consistency of LAB data delivery, display/export, independent browser-QA calculations and the QA-only paused 3D raster oracle. No model, Cargo or browser execution.

independent_saved_observation_consistenc.method: Independent Python over saved original JSON, with exact integer arithmetic and exported floating-value arithmetic; no producer, UI or validation helper imported. Results and comparisons were not overwritten or regenerated.
independent_saved_observation_consistenc.limits: Consistency of retained published observations is not a new simulation, per-tick ledger validation, kernel reproducibility or build attestation.

display_and_availability.integer_strings: Exact canonical decimal strings, including scales/counters above 2^53, stay strings in DOM and original downloads. BigInt is used for independent exact differences, without Number narrowing.
display_and_availability.float_presentation: Plot path serialization uses six decimals; floating readouts use six exponential decimals. These are presentation rules and do not alter exact counters or original JSON bytes.
display_and_availability.units: Model time is tick*30 s; declared concentrations are mol/m3, free pools and structural biomass are mol; bath/internal energy is J, energy scales are units/J, temperature is K, exchange is 1/s.
display_and_availability.plots: Only retained observations; shared y-domain is actual displayed raw maximum or 1 if zero. Four paired seed curves per arm, lines are visual guides; starvation terminates at retained tick454, with no zero fill or extrapolation.
display_and_availability.sample_comparison_separation: Selecting a retained sample does not invent a paired comparison; only existing landmark/latest-common records are displayed. No pooled range across different endpoints.
display_and_availability.ledger: Genesis checked residual is null/unknown; copied checked residual strings remain exact and are not new checks of unretained transitions.
display_and_availability.evolution_limits: Four paired seeds are not 24 independent replicates. Current living kinetics alleles, historical richness, maximum generation and peak cells remain distinct; no full genomes, individual cells, positions, species, fitness or evolutionary discovery is inferred.

browser_qa_source_review.expected_runtime: Official pinned Playwright 1.61.1, protected sandbox and observed argv guards; exact clean HEAD/tree and actual served byte checks.
browser_qa_source_review.raw_arithmetic: QA independently recomputes five integer metrics for 140 landmark plus 20 latest-common pairs from retained original results, checking BIO scales before differences.
browser_qa_source_review.dom_paired_records: QA compares all nine displayed paired metrics and published range min/max/width/count against pinned original comparisons.json. Floating paired differences/ranges are not independently recomputed by the browser oracle.
browser_qa_source_review.svg_math: Expected domain and coordinates are computed from original exported values without the production adapter: x=68+(sample_time/xmax)*520; y=160-(raw_metric/ymax)*148. M/L path points and observation dots are checked with 1e-5 SVG-unit tolerance for six-decimal path serialization.
browser_qa_source_review.other_contracts: 24 real run matrix, all 24 genesis/terminal details, baseline1800 histogram, mutation-off, starvation454/common400/landmark500, deep URL/back/reload/keyboard, desktop/short/390/320 PNGs, raw response bytes, cleanup and transport-integrity negative control are required.
browser_qa_source_review.integrity_negative: Same-length raw transport-byte mutation preserves JSON values but changes SHA; fail before displaying data. It is not a changed model trajectory.

paused_3d_qa_repair.contract: Compare exact dimensions and every decoded full compositor RGBA byte. Opaque RGB normalizes alpha to 255. No masks, crops, pixel tolerance or repeated capture until success.
paused_3d_qa_repair.diagnostics: One baseline/30/60 original PNG each plus raw/decoded SHA, mismatch pixel count/bounds and actual API, camera, viewport, mode, revision, drawn tick and layer facts before/after every capture are retained before identity assertions.

independent_synthetic_run.controls: All five PNG filters; alternate opaque RGB/RGBA encodings of known identical pixels; single RGB or alpha-byte difference; dimensions and mismatch bounds; invalid signature/filter/oversized image refusal.

paused_3d_qa_repair.fps_limit: 30/60 are requested screen cadence settings, not achieved-FPS measurements.
paused_3d_qa_repair.old_failure: Main5bea run37241483046 remains FAIL; retained JPEG/API evidence does not resolve the prior encoded-PNG mismatch. The new exact-raster oracle does not retroactively pass that run.
paused_3d_qa_repair.actual_fixed_gate_status: Coordinator reports exact79 jobSUCCESS; original large artifact not yet independently reviewed here, so no actual3D acceptance verdict.
